SELECT id, name, code, sort, data_scope, status FROM sys_role WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (name, code, sort, data_scope, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, deleted, version) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, COALESCE(#{sort}, 0), COALESCE(#{dataScope}, 5), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{version}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET deleted = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
